Signals from Singapore · updated 6 October 2026

From AI capacity to real-world value.

Recent public signals put a practical test at the centre of Singapore’s AI agenda: can organisations turn capacity into redesigned workflows and demonstrable value? A 5 October speech also described an ecosystem built around trust, talent and solutions developed, deployed and adapted in Singapore. These are stated priorities; evidence of outcomes is still the next thing to track.

Sources: MDDI, 23 September 2026: AI capacity and real-world value · MDDI, 5 October 2026: trust, talent and deployment
